hibernate-mapping.query: from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.klantId = :KlantId order by c.id asc
from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.klantId = :KlantId order by c.factuurDatum desc
from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.dierId = :DierId order by c.factuurNummer asc
select count(klantId) from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.klantId = :Id
select count(hondenschoolCursusId) from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.hondenschoolCursusId = :Id
select f from HondenschoolFactuur as f where id in (:ids)

from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.factuurDatum is not null and (c.eersteHerinnering is null or (year(c.eersteHerinnering) = year(:HerinneringDatum)) and month(c.eersteHerinnering) = month(:HerinneringDatum) and day(c.eersteHerinnering) = day(:HerinneringDatum)) and c.tweedeHerinnering is null and c.factuurDatum < :EersteHerinnering

from HondenschoolFactuur as c where c.factuurDatum is not null and c.eersteHerinnering is not null and (c.tweedeHerinnering is null or (year(c.tweedeHerinnering) = year(:HerinneringDatum)) and month(c.tweedeHerinnering) = month(:HerinneringDatum) and day(c.tweedeHerinnering) = day(:HerinneringDatum)) and c.eersteHerinnering < :TweedeHerinnering
select distinct(f) from HondenschoolFactuur as f join f.betalingen as b where not b.betaalDatum is null and b.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and b.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum order by f.factuurNummer
select distinct(f) from HondenschoolFactuur as f where f.totaalBedrag - f.totaalBetaald > 0 and not f.factuurDatum is null and f.factuurDatum <= :Datum order by f.factuurNummer

select distinct f from HondenschoolFactuur as f join f.betalingen as betaling where (not betaling.betaalDatum is null and betaling.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and betaling.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum) order by f.factuurNummer
select distinct f from HondenschoolFactuur as f join f.betalingen as b where (not b.betaalDatum is null and b.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and b.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum)
